name: agenthub-relay
description: Hand coding jobs to Codex, Claude Code or DeepSeek Harness in isolated git worktrees, and keep a waiting Claude Code planner's prompt cache warm.

keep_alive.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keep_alive.description: While relay jobs run and this session is idle, refresh the main conversation's prompt cache with a fork before its one-hour lifetime ends. Needs the one-hour cache TTL.

interval_minutes.title: Keep-alive interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: Refresh the cache this long after the last request or refresh. Must stay below the 60-minute TTL.

ceiling_hours.title: Keep-alive ceiling (hours)
ceiling_hours.description: Stop refreshing once this long has passed since your last real request.

wake_on_finish.title: Wake the session when a job ends
wake_on_finish.description: When a job this session watched ends and nobody has read its result, start a turn that asks Claude to review it.
